question: What spatial extent and dual fruits are granted by this sacred presence?
premises: The influence extends on all sides.
The extent measures only one krośa.
The granted fruits are enjoyment and liberation.
inference: Within a radius of one krośa on all sides, this presence bestows both worldly enjoyment and spiritual liberation.
uncertainties: The exact length of a krośa is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: On all sides for the measure of one krośa, it grants the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.
